blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A firearm was confiscated from a 13-year-old student at school in President Quirino, Sultan Kudarat, the Philippine National Police (PNP) reported. According to the PNP, a 9mm pistol with eight rounds of ammunition was found inside the student’s bag. Authorities recovered the firearm and ammunition after the student voluntarily opened his bag
